skills.name: MSA Gauge R&R
skills.usefulness: Separates equipment, operator and part variation from repeated measurements.
skills.audience: quality teams, technicians, labs and students.
skills.impact: Reproducible local measurement studies without paid analysis software.
skills.impact_evidence: Potential benefit inferred from supported workflow; no adoption or savings measured.
skills.changes: Replaced empty Claude workbook scaffold with a Python standard-library ANOVA analyzer, populated JSON/HTML, Codex instructions and portable installation.
skills.validation: 18 tests; independent exact arithmetic; native Codex install; Windows/Linux CI passed.
skills.limitations: Balanced crossed variable studies only; no automatic acceptance, calibration certification or confidence intervals; no physical equipment validated.
skills.learning: Separate %contribution from %study variation, retain interaction explicitly, and reject precision loss instead of reporting false zero.
